reviewType: Fresh-context independent read-only R3 freshness correction proposal review

independence.networkAccess: Read-only access limited to the three expressly permitted public Google API documentation URLs.

checks: Read repository instructions, governing REV18 appendix, BUILD_STATE, operative handoff, accepted P9 evidence and R3 kickoff.
Inspected all nine changed paths and the blocker receipts, contract assessment and validation evidence.
Verified clean exact candidate HEAD and branch; candidate is the baseline's direct child and descends from the pinned delivered baseline.
Recomputed manifest SHA256, complete changed-path equality and all nine candidate Git-blob hashes; working-tree files match candidate blobs.
Verified BUILD_STATE changes only r3CatalogRefresh.status. Grants, supplemental verification requirements and reserved effects remain unchanged.
Verified the entire earlier handoff and both kickoff documents remain byte-identical suffixes.
Reverified original policy, connector proposal and connector policy reviews against their own manifest digests, candidate commits, complete change sets and every listed candidate blob.
Confirmed canonical plan, decisions, policy code, tests, prior reviews, authority records, product code, publications and historical evidence remain unchanged from baseline.
Inspected the unchanged sanitizer and confirmed it still rejects unequal file and revision timestamps.
Independently ran R3 governance and revision-sanitizer synthetic tests: PASS.
Independently ran baseline-to-candidate git diff --check: PASS.
Independently ran build-plan validation: exit 1 with exactly the three reserved REV18 diagnostics.
Inspected existing successful full test, typecheck and build evidence for unchanged implementation.

assessment.blocker: Sanitized receipts document two permitted metadata/revision observations in attempt 1, with 25 returned records and one matching record per observation. The second receipt establishes a 141-millisecond timestamp difference. Both observations failed the existing gate; no accepted revision token or cell capture is recorded.
assessment.proposal: The replacement is precise: four bounded observations surrounding two complete native captures; equal connector-reported tokens; independently stable file and revision timestamps; equal complete bounded capture digests; unchanged identity, privacy, scope and attempt limits.
assessment.gateChange: The proposal explicitly removes an independently reviewed cross-resource timestamp equality requirement. It correctly requires direct informed approval, a prospective policy/state/test amendment and independent policy PASS before further source calls.
assessment.residualRisk: The proposal clearly states that stable observations may still reflect stale or incomplete connector responses and do not establish true server head, cryptographic revision-to-cell binding, transactional snapshot consistency, complete revision history or current official scholarship facts.
assessment.preservation: Original grants remain valid. Attempt 1 remains consumed, leaving at most two complete attempts after approval. Source reconciliation and mapping review still precede product edits; R3 completion and R4 authority remain separate.

documentationVerification: Confirmed separately defined file modifiedTime and server-change version semantics in the [File resource](https://developers.google.com/workspace/drive/api/reference/rest/v3/files).

Confirmed the distinct revision modifiedTime definition in the [Revision resource](https://developers.google.com/workspace/drive/api/reference/rest/v3/revisions). The inspected definitions do not promise cross-resource equality.
Confirmed potentially omitted older revision history in [Manage file revisions](https://developers.google.com/workspace/drive/api/guides/manage-revisions).

errors: PLAN-REV18 requires a committed manifest/review attestation in current history

limits: PASS applies only to the exact proposal candidate and manifest; it supplies no authority to implement or execute the replacement rule.
Live workbook observations and sanitization execution were assessed from retained evidence, not independently repeated.
No claim is made that 141 milliseconds is normal or that the reported revision was the true server head.
Full test/typecheck/build evidence was inspected rather than rerun; implementation is unchanged.
The three canonical diagnostics remain explicit failures.
